entries.7f8f33647c94c665: With the pulp and paper business at its core, the company manufactures printing and writing paper, paperboard, pulp and functional materials, and sells them to domestic and overseas customers through sales subsidiaries and agents to earn revenue.
entries.9b266b1e4941eb0e: Its strengths are cost competitiveness, based on the highly efficient operation of the Niigata Plant, the largest core plant in Japan by scale, and environmental competitiveness, which leads the domestic paper and pulp industry. It states that, in its strategic business alliance with Daio Paper Corporation, it has built up earnings improvements through cost-reduction measures in production technology, raw material procurement and product logistics.
entries.9dc3cd664f96daf8: Under the long-term management vision "Vision 2030," the company started the "Medium-Term Management Plan 2030" in April 2026 as the final step toward realizing that vision.
entries.a1aac432e4b4666d: Under the long-term management vision "Vision 2030," the company started the "Medium-Term Management Plan 2030" in April 2026 as the final step toward realizing that vision. Its three basic policies are "accelerating the shift in business portfolio," "establishing superiority through enhanced competitiveness" and "creating value through sustainability management," and it states that it will focus on four areas: expanding the packaging business, reconstructing white paperboard, expanding exports and strategic investment.
